wb.firstPass.exists.en: This version already has an AI first pass. Fork a new draft to run it again.
wb.firstPass.exists.zh: 该版本已有 AI 初稿。如需重新生成，请另起新草稿。

wb.firstPass.noLines.en: No lines to adapt — ingest a subtitle file first.
wb.firstPass.noLines.zh: 没有可改编的台词，请先导入字幕文件。

wb.ai.unavailable.hint.en: AI is unavailable — set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on the server.
wb.ai.unavailable.hint.zh: AI 不可用：请在服务器上设置 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY。

wb.submit.noVersion.en: Generate the English draft before sending this episode.
wb.submit.noVersion.zh: 请先生成英文初稿，再提交本集。

wb.submit.frozen.en: This version has already been submitted.

wb.submit.lines.en: {n} of {total} lines are ready. Finish every English line before sending this episode.
wb.submit.lines.zh: {n} / {total} 句台词已就绪。请完成所有英文台词后再提交。

wb.submit.responses.en: Respond to {n} producer request(s) before sending the revision.
wb.submit.responses.zh: 提交修订稿前，请先回应 {n} 条制片方修改要求。

wb.submit.scenes.en: {n} of {total} scenes are ready — review and mark every scene ready before sending.
wb.submit.scenes.zh: {n} / {total} 场已就绪。请审核并将每一场标记为就绪后再提交。

wb.fork.reviewPending.en: Wait for the producer to decide the remaining {n} scene(s) before creating a revision.
wb.fork.reviewPending.zh: 请等待制片方审核剩余 {n} 个场景后再创建修订稿。

wb.frozen.hint.en: This version is frozen. Fork a new draft to edit.
wb.frozen.hint.zh: 该版本已冻结，如需修改请另起新草稿。

wb.frozen.inReview.en: Read only — this version is with the producer for review. Snapshot {sha}.
wb.frozen.inReview.zh: 只读：该版本正在由制片方审核。快照 {sha}。

wb.frozen.approved.en: Read only — this version was approved by the producer. Snapshot {sha}.
wb.frozen.approved.zh: 只读：该版本已由制片方通过。快照 {sha}。

wb.player.noVideo.en: No video attached — timecodes still drive the script
wb.player.noVideo.zh: 未上传视频，时间码仍可驱动剧本

wb.scene.counter.zh: 第 {n} 场 / 共 {total} 场

wb.scene.notReady.en: {n} line(s) in this scene still need a complete English adaptation.
wb.scene.notReady.zh: 本场仍有 {n} 句台词需要完成英文改编。

wb.workflow.start.body.en: Start the AI pass, then review every English line before marking scenes ready.
wb.workflow.start.body.zh: 先生成 AI 初稿，再逐句审核英文改编，最后将场景标记为就绪。

wb.workflow.manual.body.en: AI is not configured, but you can still continue. Create editable blank lines, then translate each one before marking scenes ready.
wb.workflow.manual.body.zh: 当前未配置 AI，但仍可继续。先创建可编辑的空白台词，再逐句翻译并将场景标记为就绪。

wb.workflow.blocked.title.zh: 英文初稿暂时无法生成

wb.workflow.blocked.body.en: AI is not configured on this server. Ask an administrator to connect the Anthropic API before this episode can move forward.
wb.workflow.blocked.body.zh: 当前服务器尚未配置 AI。请联系管理员连接 Anthropic API，之后才能继续本集。

wb.workflow.edit.body.en: {n} line(s) still need complete English text, rationale, or back-translation. Select each highlighted line and finish it.
wb.workflow.edit.body.zh: 仍有 {n} 句缺少完整的英文台词、改编说明或回译。请选择并完成这些台词。

wb.workflow.readyScenes.body.en: All lines are complete. Review the bilingual result, then mark the remaining {n} scene(s) ready for the producer.
wb.workflow.readyScenes.body.zh: 所有台词均已完成。请检查双语结果，并将剩余 {n} 场标记为可提交制片方。

wb.workflow.send.title.en: Ready to send to the producer

wb.workflow.send.body.en: Every line and scene is ready. Send this version to freeze it and begin producer review.
wb.workflow.send.body.zh: 所有台词与场景均已就绪。提交后版本将被冻结，并开始制片方审核。

wb.workflow.waiting.body.en: The submitted snapshot is read-only. No staff action is needed until the producer decides or requests an alternative.
wb.workflow.waiting.body.zh: 已提交的快照为只读。制片方作出决定或要求替代方案前，Pulsar 团队无需操作。

wb.workflow.returned.title.zh: 制片方要求修改 {n} 个场景

wb.workflow.returned.body.en: Read the producer notes below, create a revision, address each request, and send the new version back.
wb.workflow.returned.body.zh: 请查看下方制片方备注，创建修订稿，逐项处理后重新提交。

wb.workflow.feedbackPending.title.en: Producer feedback received — review still in progress
wb.workflow.feedbackPending.title.zh: 已收到制片方反馈 — 审核仍在进行

wb.workflow.feedbackPending.body.en: The request is visible below. Wait for the producer to decide the remaining {n} scene(s), then create one revision that addresses all feedback.
wb.workflow.feedbackPending.body.zh: 修改要求如下。请等待制片方审核剩余 {n} 个场景，再创建一个修订稿集中处理所有反馈。

wb.workflow.approved.body.en: The approved snapshot is final and ready to export. Create a revision only if a new change is required.
wb.workflow.approved.body.zh: 已批准快照为最终版本，可直接导出。只有需要新改动时才创建修订稿。

wb.requests.title.zh: {n} 条带时间码的修改要求

wb.requests.frozenHelp.en: The request and exact note are shown below. Create a revision to edit the submitted version.
wb.requests.frozenHelp.zh: 修改要求和具体备注如下。请创建修订稿以编辑已提交版本。

wb.requests.pendingHelp.en: The request and exact note are shown below. The producer still has {n} scene(s) to decide; revision editing unlocks when their review is complete.
wb.requests.pendingHelp.zh: 修改要求和具体备注如下。制片方仍有 {n} 个场景待审核；全部审核完成后即可创建修订稿。

wb.requests.draftHelp.en: You are editing the revision. Resolve each note below, mark the scene ready again, then send the new version to the producer.
wb.requests.draftHelp.zh: 您正在编辑修订稿。请逐项处理以下备注，重新将场景标记为就绪，再提交给制片方。

wb.requests.responseReason.zh: Pulsar 修改了什么，以及原因

wb.requests.responsePlaceholder.en: Explain how the revised line follows the request, or why a different solution works better…
wb.requests.responsePlaceholder.zh: 说明修订后的台词如何落实该要求，或为何采用其他方案更合适…

wb.lines.empty.en: No lines in this episode yet.

wb.adapted.noVersion.hint.en: Run the AI first pass to draft every line of this episode.
wb.adapted.noVersion.hint.zh: 生成 AI 初稿，为本集每一句台词起草改编。

wb.adapted.manualHint.en: Use Start manual draft above to create editable English lines without AI.
wb.adapted.manualHint.zh: 点击上方“开始手动改编”，无需 AI 即可创建可编辑的英文台词。

wb.adapted.pick.en: Select a line on the left.
wb.adapted.pick.zh: 请在左侧选择一句台词。

wb.adapted.noLine.en: This line has no adaptation yet.

wb.major.on.en: Marked as a major change — the producer sees it first. Click to unmark.
wb.major.on.zh: 已标记为重大改动，制片方会优先看到。点击取消。

wb.major.off.en: Mark as a major change for the producer
wb.major.off.zh: 标记为重大改动，提示制片方

wb.alt.empty.en: No alternatives yet — generate up to three.
wb.alt.empty.zh: 暂无替代方案，可生成最多三条。

wb.alt.emptyNoAi.zh: 这句台词没有替代方案。

wb.tools.instruction.ph.en: e.g. make it angrier, keep it under eight words
wb.tools.instruction.ph.zh: 例如：语气更愤怒，控制在八个词以内
